units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 230px head-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Original sources and native 128px Godot phases reviewed: visible winch crank idle, two-handed shove/recovery, reload/aim/release, recoil/brace, raised near-hand rally, reciprocal eight-phase walk and grounded collapse. Wrong-arm, wrong-knee, clipped-tip and undersized gesture poses excluded. One fixed anatomical scale per original source; full weapon silhouettes and sole grounding preserved. Imported battle/map rendering checked separately.
